**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement contains no exclusivity, sole-supplier, or requirements obligation binding 551 FX IB Associates. The only "exclusive" references either favour Vendor's retained freedom to license others (p0030, p0043 — neutral to us), or are unrelated (exclusive jurisdiction, entire-agreement, non-exclusive remedy). The Right of First Refusal is a change-of-control right-to-match that expressly leaves us free to close with the third party once the Exercise Period lapses, so it falls under MFN/change-of-control review rather than EXCLUSIVITY and should not be double-flagged here. No redline issued.
